notes: The harvested bubble sort (harvested/edexcel/EDX-75-example-bubble-sort) with its last line, SEND nums TO DISPLAY, replaced by a FOR EACH loop that sends each element (EDX-75's hint, QUESTIONS.md 14). WHILE repeats until a pass makes no swap (EDX-50); FOR runs i from 0 to LENGTH(nums) - 2 inclusive (EDX-53, EDX-90); elements are read and written by index from 0 (EDX-22, EDX-23). Each SEND prints one line (EDX-70).
